source: Agriculture Sector Development Project (ASDP), ADB Loan No. 2023-CAM(SF), Guide No.1: Coconut-damaging beetle and protective measures, prepared by Kampot Province Department of Agricultural Extension, 2008
text: Closing summary of the guide: to protect coconut production going forward, farmers and local authorities are urged to help sustain the results already achieved (i.e. the established Asecodes wasp populations and reduced beetle damage) so that the beetle outbreak does not return. The wasp-based biological control approach is presented as a long-term, lower-cost, and environmentally safer solution and is framed as being in the national interest, given how widely coconut palms are grown across Cambodian households and how many household products depend on a healthy tree, as outlined in the tree-uses overview at the start of the guide.
